services.title: Website development
services.intro: Turn your website into a clear, credible reason to choose your business.
services.problem: An outdated website makes a good business harder to trust. Slow pages, confusing navigation and unclear enquiries lose the people you worked hard to reach.
services.solution: We connect brand, content and engineering in a website built around what your customers need to understand and do next.

questions.question: Can you improve our existing website?
questions.answer: Yes. We start with an audit of your content, integrations and hosting, then agree what to preserve and what needs to change.

questions.question: Will our team be able to update content?
questions.answer: We agree an editing workflow during discovery and provide the access, documentation and training included in your scope.

services.title: Custom software
services.intro: Move beyond spreadsheets, disconnected tools and workarounds.
services.problem: When essential processes live across inboxes and spreadsheets, people repeat work and leaders struggle to see what is happening.
services.solution: We map the workflow with your team and build a focused platform that connects people, information and decisions.

questions.question: How do we avoid building the wrong thing?
questions.answer: Discovery identifies the users, constraints and measurable outcomes. We validate a focused scope before committing to a larger build.

questions.question: Can you integrate with existing systems?
questions.answer: We assess documentation, access, security requirements and API limitations before proposing an integration approach.

services.title: Mobile app development
services.intro: Give customers and teams a simpler way to get things done on mobile.
services.problem: A desktop process does not always work in the field. Connectivity, device constraints and complex screens can get in the way of essential tasks.
services.solution: We design mobile journeys around real environments, then choose an appropriate native, cross-platform or web-based approach.

questions.question: Do we need an app or a mobile website?
questions.answer: We assess your users, distribution needs, device features and budget. A responsive website can be the better starting point.

questions.question: Can the product work with limited connectivity?
questions.answer: We can plan offline workflows, synchronization and conflict handling where the business case and technical constraints support them.

services.title: AI & automation
services.intro: Find practical ways to automate work, with people and governance in the loop.
services.problem: AI promises are easy to buy. Finding a useful, responsible application within your existing processes is harder.
services.solution: We assess data readiness, identify repeatable workflows and test a bounded use case before recommending wider adoption.

questions.question: Do we need to share sensitive business data?
questions.answer: We first define the minimum data required, access controls and provider terms. Sensitive information should not be shared before those decisions are agreed.

questions.question: Will AI replace our existing systems?
questions.answer: Usually the starting point is a specific workflow. We assess how automation fits the tools and people you already rely on.

services.title: Technology consulting
services.intro: Make technology decisions with a clear view of cost, risk and business value.
services.problem: Conflicting vendor advice and disconnected systems make it difficult to decide what to invest in next.
services.solution: We work with business and technical stakeholders to define priorities, assess options and create a practical delivery roadmap.

questions.question: Can you work with our internal IT team?
questions.answer: Yes. We agree responsibilities, decision points and knowledge transfer so recommendations can be put into practice.

questions.question: What will we have at the end of discovery?
questions.answer: The agreed outputs can include a problem definition, prioritized requirements, architecture options, risks and a phased implementation plan.

services.title: Hardware & infrastructure
services.intro: Connect the right equipment, deployment plan and support to the work ahead.
services.problem: Hardware purchased without a clear operating plan can leave teams with compatibility issues, fragmented ownership and unexpected support needs.
services.solution: We help define requirements, assess equipment options and coordinate configuration, integration and handover around your environment.

questions.question: Can you support a procurement process?
questions.answer: We can help clarify specifications, evaluate compatibility and document the scope. Commercial terms and supplier warranties are agreed for each engagement.

questions.question: Do you provide ongoing maintenance?
questions.answer: Support responsibilities, coverage and response arrangements are defined in the project agreement; they are not assumed or guaranteed.

faqs.question: Where do you work?
faqs.answer: Ark Builders is based in Lagos, Nigeria, and welcomes enquiries from local and international organizations. Delivery arrangements are agreed during discovery.

faqs.question: What size of project can we discuss?
faqs.answer: Tell us your goals and budget range. We assess fit and scope before making a proposal, including focused projects and larger phased programmes.

faqs.question: What happens after I send a project brief?
faqs.answer: We review the context in WhatsApp, clarify the need and agree the next step. Sending a brief does not create a contract or commit you to a project.
